name: osint-dezinformacia-monitor
description: Continuous OSINT monitor that ingests feeds, normalizes text, detects misinformation via regex/ML, enriches with Wikidata, and prepares fact-checked replies.

steps.name: ingest-feeds
steps.prompt_template: Ingest recent data from the following OSINT sources: {{input}}. Use web_fetch and web_search to gather content, authors, and timestamps.

steps.name: ingest-dennikn
steps.prompt_template: Fetch the latest fact-check articles and investigative reports from Denník N (dennikn.sk). Focus on misinformation coverage, corrections, and editorial fact-checks published in the last 24 hours. Extract claim_text, author, url, publish_date for each item.

steps.name: merge-sources
steps.prompt_template: Merge and deduplicate the feed data {{raw_feeds}} and Denník N data {{dennikn_data}} into a unified source list. Remove exact duplicates by URL fingerprint. Output merged array.

steps.name: translate-content
steps.prompt_template: Translate all non-English content in {{merged_raw}} to English. Preserve original text alongside the translation. Source languages include Slovak (SK), Czech (CZ), and Hungarian (HU).

steps.name: normalize-content
steps.prompt_template: Normalize the raw data: {{translated_data}}. Remove HTML tags, clean whitespace, and extract structured claim objects (claim_text, author, source_url, publish_date).

steps.name: detect-misinformation
steps.prompt_template: Analyze {{normalized_data}} for misinformation. Use regex patterns for known Slovak/Czech disinformation keywords and cross-reference with the Google Fact Check API. Flag suspicious statements with a confidence score 0-100.

steps.name: analyze-visual-claims
steps.prompt_template: For any items in {{flagged_statements}} that contain image URLs, embedded screenshots, or meme content, perform visual analysis. Detect manipulated images, misleading infographics, or deepfake indicators. Append visual_analysis field to each flagged item where applicable.

steps.name: enrich-with-context
steps.prompt_template: For each flagged statement in {{visually_enriched_statements}}, search Wikidata and authoritative news archives to add context and verified entity information. Cross-reference with dennikn.sk fact-check archive.

steps.name: qa-review
steps.prompt_template: Review the enriched graph {{enriched_graph}} for quality and consistency. Verify that each flagged statement has sufficient evidence, that confidence scores are calibrated, and that visual analysis results are incorporated. Remove or downgrade items with insufficient evidence before response drafting.

steps.name: prepare-responses
steps.prompt_template: Based on the QA-approved enriched context: {{qa_approved}}, draft polite but factual corrections in both Slovak and English. Prepare as alerts for Slack and drafts for social media platforms.
